run_sft_trainer: run the SFTTrainer to finetune a diffusion transformer model with full or LoRA finetuning
prepare_models_sft_trainer: prepare models by loading diffusion components and setting up transformer for training
prepare_dataset_sft_trainer: prepare dataset by loading dataset configs, initializing iterable datasets, and creating dataloaders
train_sft_trainer: train the transformer model with forward pass, loss computation, gradient clipping, and optimizer steps
validate_sft_trainer: validate the trained model on a validation dataset and generate image or video artifacts
